title: ioctl_reset allows reset after error without FINALIZE
description: ioctl_reset() checks 'if (\!state->finalized) return -EINVAL' but the DESIGN.md comment says RESET is for error recovery as well. When state->error==true and state->finalized==false (e.g. update() failed mid-stream), there is no way to recover via RESET — the fd is permanently dead even though the session key material is intact. The UAPI header says 'Call CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_RESET to recover the fd for a new operation (same key)' after errors, but ioctl_reset() refuses if \!finalized. Trigger: INIT → SET_IV → write() returns -EIO (error=true, finalized=false) → RESET → returns -EINVAL → fd is unrecoverable despite the documented contract.
